diagnosis.what_happened: validation-agent executed an unconditional, non-branching mechanical check for '3-table regression structure' on an SEM manuscript, failing to distinguish between regression and SEM deliverables.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: SEM manuscripts were incorrectly flagged as failing validation due to missing regression-specific tables.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: validation-agent should have checked the methodology type and conditionally bypassed the 3-table regression requirement for SEM manuscripts.
diagnosis.rationale_why: SEM and Regression have different reporting structures. Enforcing regression invariants on SEM artifacts produces false negatives in validation.

desired_behavior: validation-agent must implement conditional branching in thesis-integrity-auditor to apply the 3-table regression invariant only to regression manuscripts, bypassing it for SEM manuscripts.
generalization: Validation invariants must be methodology-aware and only apply strictly to the statistical method they were designed for.

evidence.observed_value: FAIL with 2 checks failed due to invalid validation invariant
